The role focuses on fixed and rotating equipment such as boilers, transformers, turbines, pumps, and compressors, applying FMEA, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and condition-based maintenance (CBM) techniques. SmartSignal or similar product experience is highly preferred. Candidates must have 58 years of on-the-ground OM experience in Oil Gas, Fossil Power, or Renewable Power, and be proficient in Python with working knowledge of SQL and/or R. Reliability engineering knowledge is a strong plus.
Roles and Responsibilities
Translate asset strategies and failure modes into analytics: identify critical tags/signals, define data requirements, and map sensor data to failure mechanisms and operational states.
Perform time-series analysis on industrial data (historian/SCADA/PLC, CMMS/EAM/APM) to detect degradation, anomalies, and precursors to failure; engineer features aligned to specific failure modes.
Build and validate analytics in Python (rules, thresholds, statistical/ML methods) to capture early warning indicators for CBM and predictive maintenance; document assumptions and acceptance criteria.
Apply and document FMEA and RCA; collaborate with SMEs to define detection logic and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) tied to operating procedures and maintenance plans.
Configure and support deployment of asset health analytics in APM/condition monitoring platforms (e.g., SmartSignal or equivalent), including tag mapping, thresholds, alert logic, and tuning; support monitoring and continuous improvement.
Partner with data/platform engineering and data scientists to implement pipelines, ensure data quality/lineage, and operationalize analytics per established standards.
Create clear narratives and playbooks linking alerts to failure mechanisms and recommended actions; train operations/maintenance teams on interpretation and response.
Contribute reusable templates (FMEA libraries, failure signatures, tagging standards) and coach junior engineers/analysts on asset analytics best practices.
Adhere to governance, safety, and compliance requirements; ensure secure handling of operational data and alignment with plant procedures and SLAs.
Education Qualification
For roles outside USA: Bachelors Degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Instrumentation) or STEM with minimum 8 years of total experience, including 58 years of hands-on operations and maintenance experience in Oil Gas, Fossil Power, or Renewable Power.
For roles in USA: Bachelors Degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Instrumentation) or STEM with minimum 8 years of experience.
